description: This Java source file defines the AsmAnalyzer class which analyzes Java bytecode contained within JAR files, using ASM library classes, to parse, filter, and process class information relevant to the Android build process.

classes.name: AsmAnalyzer
classes.description: A helper class that provides methods to parse jars, retrieve class names, and filter classes based on custom criteria.

methods.name: parseInputJar
methods.description: Parses a specified JAR file to extract all classes as ClassReader objects, returning a map from class name to ClassReader.

methods.name: classReaderToAsmName
methods.description: Converts a ClassReader object into its fully qualified ASM class name.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters the set of classes in-place based on a provided filtering criterion, removing classes that do not meet the acceptance criteria.
